title: Forescout: BankWeaver campaign abused an exposed Temenos Quantum Fabric authentication service at a financial institution
date_note: Forescout published its report on 19 November; it says the breach was found in early September and gives no date for the intrusion itself. CyberPress relayed it on 20 November.
org: Unnamed financial institution (Temenos Quantum Fabric customer)
summary: Forescout Research says a campaign it calls BankWeaver abused an internet-facing authentication service set to anonymous access in a financial institution's Temenos Quantum Fabric deployment, giving administrative functions; it confirmed one compromise. Two payloads, FabricShell and FabricShadow, are named. Temenos released updates and guidance to make the service private. Forescout found six more banks that appeared to share the configuration and has not confirmed compromise.
plain: Security firm Forescout says attackers got into a bank's digital banking back end through a login service left open to anonymous access. Temenos has issued guidance to make the service private.
exec: Forescout says one financial institution was compromised through an exposed service; six other banks appeared to share the same setup.
action: Apply Temenos's configuration updates and guidance, set privileged authentication services to private, and remove direct internet access to Fabric and Spotlight administration services.
impact: Forescout found six additional banks that appeared to share the same configuration and exposure; it has not confirmed compromise at them.

sources.name: Forescout Research: BankWeaver Campaign Abuses Digital Banking Middleware to Deploy Web Shells

validation.note: Primary: Forescout Research (the investigating firm) read on 21 Nov; CyberPress relays it. Forescout names no actor and no CVE. Temenos advisory itself not read; its guidance is as relayed by Forescout.

review.note: Compared with Forescout report (19 Nov) and CyberPress: BankWeaver, anonymous-access auth service, one confirmed compromise, FabricShell/FabricShadow, Temenos updates and guidance, six banks unconfirmed, early September, no actor or CVE
